name: Healing Oil
description: a creature can automatically stabilize a dying creature by using an action to smear some of its oily secretion on the dying creature’s flesh. A similar application on an already-stable creature or one with 1 or more hit points acts as a potion of healing, restoring 2d4 + 2 hit points. Alternatively, the creature’s secretion can have the effect of a lesser restoration spell. However, any creature receiving a creature’s Healing Oil must make a successful DC 13 Constitution saving throw or be slowed for 1 minute.
